notes: Günter Schabowski faces the international press at the GDR press center. He has a note on new travel rules that he has barely read. Times in this file are Central European Time.

location: Asked when the new rules take effect, Schabowski says they apply immediately. He remarks that it is 7:00 p.m. and takes that question as the last. The rules had been meant for the next day, and the border posts have not been told.

description: Reuters says the border is open
notes: The wire moves the story within minutes. West German television repeats it. No order has reached the guards.
Crowds press the checkpoint. Around 10:30 p.m. the guards raise the barrier rather than hold the line. It is the first crossing to open. The others follow through the night.
East and West Berliners spend the next day on and around the Wall. The checkpoints stay open.
